Power measurements show fiber loss essentially normal: A-TX -0.03 dBm, B-ODF -8.31 dBm => loss 8.28 dB ~ commissioning 8.34 dB. B-RX -23.32 dBm => attenuator loss = B-ODF - B-RX = 15.01 dB. But still need to rule out connector issues or fiber break. The PM shows degradation started 2026-10-21 ~ min -23.37, alarm raised 2026-10-22 04:00. SC-08 work on 2026-10-20 could be cause of fiber damage. However fiber loss measurement shows normal 8.28 dB. If there was a macrobend or break at SC-08 (route_km 27.98), OTDR would show loss. Embedded OTDR and OTDR event table can confirm. Also need inspect connectors per checklist, though power measurements suggest fiber is fine.

We should run embedded OTDR to confirm no fiber event, and inspect connectors for completeness. The fault type could be wrong_attenuator at B-ATT element_id. The checklist requires inspect connectors. Let's inspect A-ODF and B-ODF. No MID-PP in link record.

Also check tx_power and tx_bias to rule out TX degradation. Could be TX degradation but A-TX power is -0.03 dBm within spec -1 to +2. So TX fine.

Maybe also check PM for tx_power_dbm to confirm stable. Could be good.

Proceed with embedded OTDR from A and B.
